description: Search Open Library authors by name. Returns Open Library Author IDs, names, birth/death dates, top works, and subject associations. Use author IDs for openlibrary_get_author (bio, remote IDs) or openlibrary_get_author_works (list of works).

query.description: Author name search query. Partial names and alternate names work.

name: openlibrary_search_authors

birth_date.description: Birth date string. Absent when not recorded.

death_date.description: Death date string. Absent when not recorded.

ratings_average.description: Average community rating across the author's works. Absent when no ratings exist.

top_subjects.description: Most common subject tags across the author's works.

top_work.description: Title of the author's most popular work. Absent when unavailable.

work_count.description: Number of works catalogued for this author.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the page is empty (how to vary a name that matched nothing, or which offset to retry when offset ran past the end) or when the text output capped a per-author list. Absent when neither applies.

offset.description: Zero-based offset of the first returned result — echoes the requested offset, so an empty page still records the offset that produced it.

total.description: Total matching authors across all pages.

totalCount.description: Total matching authors across all pages — the upstream match count, reported even when this page is empty because offset ran past the end.

title: Search Authors
